WINDOWS_SUPPORT_PLAN.SUMMARY: Windows x86_64 support plan for Synapse. Currently deferred — Linux/macOS are the supported platforms for v2.x release line.

TECHNICAL_BLOCKERS.BLOCKER: Tree-sitter grammars compile on Windows via MSVC but require cmake + C++ build tools. Mitigation: bundle pre-compiled grammars via tree-sitter-loader or use conditional compilation. Effort: 2 days.
ONNX Runtime embedding requires platform-specific libonnxruntime.dll. Mitigation: feature-gate embeddings on Windows (lexical-only search), same as MacOS Intel approach. Effort: 1 day.

File watcher (notify crate) uses different backend on Windows (ReadDirectoryChangesW). API is cross-platform but edge cases differ. Mitigation: test watcher on Windows CI; add retry logic for transient locking. Effort: 1 day.
Unix-specific operations: symlinks, chmod, shebang scripts. Mitigation: gate Unix-specific code behind #[cfg(unix)], provide Windows equivalents where needed. Effort: 2 days.

MVP_SCOPE.INCLUDE: CLI commands (init, verify, review, refresh, status, mcp)
MVP_SCOPE.EXCLUDE: File watcher (optional, can use polling fallback)

BREAKDOWN.ITEM: Initial Windows build (MSVC toolchain, dependency resolution): 3 days
Windows CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml windows matrix): 1 day
